interpretation_limit: Four stereotactic putaminal infusions totaling 0.32 mL. The current model has no intraparenchymal compartment, so this case is not used as an exposure threshold.

evidence_kind: mechanism and local tolerability proof of concept; not GLP toxicology
interpretation_limit: 1 uL of 7.0e12 vg/mL AAV9; about two-fold endogenous GDNF increase for at least six months with no reported body-weight or food-intake signal. Target- and species-specific.

evidence_kind: lowest NHP IT dose with microscopic neural findings; not a NOAEL
interpretation_limit: Minimal-to-moderate microscopic CNS/DRG/nerve findings occurred at all tested doses, including 1.2e13 vg/NHP. No clinical correlate; CSF scaling was used for human context.

interpretation_limit: At 1.2e14 vg: hepatic-enzyme increase 6/75 (8%), thrombocytopenia 3/75 (4%), sensory disturbance 2/75 (3%); two ALT values reached 20x ULN.

evidence_kind: human intramuscular AAV route context; authorization later withdrawn
interpretation_limit: Route-matched but cross-capsid and historical. Genome copies and vector genomes are treated as an approximate modeling bridge, not an assay-equivalent conversion.
